meta.name: Maamla Legal Hai
meta.description:
Chaos collides with the letter of the law at District Court Patparganj, where quirky employees work to uphold justice — but not without a few objections.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 1 Mar 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Posham Pa Pictures · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Egregious
videos.overview: Tyagi seeks key support in his campaign for bar president. Harvard grad Anaya Shroff struggles to find her footing… and a desk.

videos.title: Darwaza
videos.overview: Ananya looks to assist a mysterious advocate in his cases. Trouble brews for Tyagi's nomination when someone complains about his bold signboard.

videos.title: Dignity
videos.overview: When a monkey causes a stir on the court premises, the lawyers are moved to strike, leading to a strain on Ananya and her first case.

videos.title: Aukaat
videos.overview: Sujata tries to drop her “foyer lawyer” status with a new client — a foul-mouthed parrot. When a big-shot lawyer arrives, Tyagi and Bagai hatch a plan.

videos.title: Touch
videos.overview: Ananya and Sujata scramble to help an inmate fulfill her dream to start a family. Tyagi has an emotional talk with his father, a retired judge.

videos.title: Biradari
videos.overview: Tyagi and his campaign land in hot water after police and lawyers clash. Ananya and Sujata contend with a fierce woman in the race.

videos.title: Kutai
videos.overview: Phorey or Tyagi? The election results are finally in — but the twists aren't over yet. Ananya turns counselor for a young woman’s case.

videos.title: Law vs Justice
videos.overview: Tyagi weighs an important decision that will change the course of his career. PP Sahab and Ananya are pulled into a landmark case.

videos.title: Without Fear or Favour
videos.overview: A cough at the oath ceremony spells trouble for Tyagi’s judgeship. Ananya faces a rival in a toxic deodorant case. Sujata and Mintu spar as partners.

videos.title: Unbiased
videos.overview: On his first day as judge, a harmless smile leads Tyagi down a controversial path. Ananya and Sujata fight for a colleague who was spanked by a woman.

videos.title: Balanced
videos.overview: Tyagi attempts to uphold a new and bold policy in the court. Sujata goes up against a man who claims a bottle of alcohol lacked a certain kick.

videos.title: Emotional Attachment
videos.overview: Ananya struggles to put her skepticism aside in an organ donation case. A karaoke invite and a condolence order cause headaches for Tyagi.

videos.title: Juvenile
videos.overview: Sujata finds a way to distract Mintu in court, while Ananya and Nayana clash over a young boy determined to lead a life of crime.

videos.title: Act of God
videos.overview: Tyagi deals with electrocutions and faulty wires on the eve of his first official inspection. Sujata attempts to settle a tricky divorce mediation case.

videos.title: Compromise
videos.overview: On Lok Adalat Day, a conman seemingly hides in the crowd. Sujata and Mintu tackle opposing sides of a case involving a dead man's wife and his partner.

videos.title: Beyond Reform
videos.overview: Tyagi faces a case that could make or break his career. Ananya plans a sting operation to get to the bottom of Nayana's plan. Sujata is caught in a lie.

meta.slogan: A courtroom comedy that brings infamous cases - where laughter is the only verdict
